title: Scalar curvature rigidity for products of convex hypersurfaces
summary: Let $N = N_{1} \times \dotsm \times N_{k}$, where each $N_{i} \subset \mathbb{R}^{n_i+1}$ is a closed strictly convex hypersurface. Let $M$ be a Riemannian spin manifold of dimension $n = \dim(N)$, and let $f \colon M \to N$ be an area non-increasing smooth map of non-zero degree. We show that $\mathrm{scal}_M \geq \mathrm{scal}_N \circ f$ implies $\mathrm{scal}_M = \mathrm{scal}_N \circ f$. Moreover, if $n \geq 3$ and $N$ has no circle factors, then every such map is a Riemannian isometry.
